title: Optimization of trimetallic Cu–Cr–Ca nanoparticle-catalyzed transesterification of amla (Phyllanthus emblica L.) seed oil: analytical characterization and fuel properties of biodiesel
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13838-13856
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00098J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Humaira Kanwal, Farooq Anwar, Ahsan Tanvir, Syed Hussain Imam Abidi, Muhammad Waseem Mumtaz
A Cu–Cr–Ca nanocatalyst was developed for transesterification of non-edible amla oil. Bifunctionality of the catalytic reaction is explored,and RSM optimized process yielded 92% amla oil biodiesel, providing a sustainable fuel alternative.
